name: BOCW Contractor Complaint
full_name: Complaint Against Unregistered Contractor under BOCW Act
description: Legal right to file complaint if contractor employs 10 or more construction workers and has not registered them under BOCW
required_documents: Proof of employment at the site
benefit_description: Contractor faces fine up to Rs 1 lakh and worker gets registered under BOCW
action: File complaint at District Labour Office, Bengaluru
official_source: Building and Other Construction Workers Act 1996, Section 7
